This is a better-targeted fix for the observed metric declines than reacting to competitor pricing pressure, which memory_73 shows leads to unsustainable retention loss when tried via promotional discounting. Verifying the two onboarding-related archived records before committing ensures the original experiments were run on comparable segments and timeframes, since the current context (competitive pricing pressure plus declining activation/onboarding) differs somewhat from when those memories were consolidated. Given only one experiment slot this week, and the primary objective of sustainable long-term qualified revenue, treating this as a standard experiment (not a broad rollout) lets us confirm the lift holds under current conditions before scaling, while avoiding the known downstream revenue/retention risk associated with promotional pricing.
